PROVIDER.description: Model provider preset. One of openrouter, anthropic, openai, nous, custom.

MODEL.description: Model ID. Empty picks the preset default (anthropic/claude-haiku-4.5, claude-haiku-4-5-20251001 or gpt-5.4-mini).

ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.description: Anthropic Console key, used when PROVIDER=anthropic.

NOUS_API_KEY.description: Nous Portal key, used when PROVIDER=nous. Empty means sign in once with hermes auth add nous over railway ssh.

API_SERVER_KEY.description: Bearer token for the HTTP API. Generated at deploy time.

API_SERVER_ENABLED.description: Enables the OpenAI-compatible API server and /health.

API_SERVER_HOST.description: Bind address for the API server inside the container.

PORT.description: API server port. Railway routes the public domain and the healthcheck here.

TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN.description: Telegram bot token from @BotFather. Leave empty to run without Telegram.

TELEGRAM_ALLOWED_USERS.description: Numeric Telegram user IDs, comma separated. Required when TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN is set. The container refuses to start without it.
